youtube.baslik: Why does a normal tympanogram after a failed screen mean no waiting? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: When a child fails the pure-tone screen twice but has normal tympanometry, the loss may be sensorineural, and the guideline calls for referral to audiology without waiting for a rescreen. A child who fails both is rescreened in 8 to 10 weeks, because middle ear fluid often clears on its own.
